transport.encoding: latin-1-compatible source; normalize extracted CSV to utf-8 for DuckDB
transport.rate_limit: monthly bulk; resolve the requested YYYY-MM partition to the latest dated mirror folder such as 2026-05-10. Data is open (no auth/payment).

parsing.notes: Latin-1-compatible source, ;-delimited, NO header — map columns by position per the RFB layout. Preserve raw ZIP members and normalize extracted CSV artifacts to UTF-8 before DuckDB ingestion because some snapshots contain dirty control bytes. Files: Empresas0..9, Estabelecimentos0..9, Socios0..9, Simples, + reference tables (Cnaes/Naturezas/Municipios/Paises/Qualificacoes/Motivos). Join on cnpj_basico. Full CNPJ = cnpj_basico+cnpj_ordem+cnpj_dv. situacao_cadastral 02=ativa/08=baixada. Resolve code lists. Redact Socios (names, masked CPF) + contact fields (LGPD). The historical Receita arquivos host returned 404/timeout headlessly; use the Casa dos Dados mirror as the fetch transport while attributing data to Receita Federal.

mapping_rules.company_id: cnpj (14-digit) / cnpj_basico (8-digit root for the entity).
mapping_rules.vat_id: null (no single VAT; ICMS via Inscrição Estadual, not in open data).

live_test_plan.smoke: Fetch one reference table (e.g. Cnaes.zip) + Empresas0.zip; parse by position; resolve a few codes.
live_test_plan.full: Download Empresas0..9 + Estabelecimentos0..9 + Socios0..9 + Simples + reference tables from the dated mirror folder; join on cnpj_basico; redact Socios; gate behind env.
